name: angular_readability_check
description: Computes the angular size (degrees) of text of a given point size viewed at a given distance, and flags whether it meets a legibility threshold (~1.0 deg for comfortable reading, ~0.35 deg absolute minimum). Use when judging a VR demo claim that UI text at distance D with point size P is 'readable'.

thresholdDeg.description: angular-size threshold in degrees; default 1.0 (comfortable reading)
